item.title: SciRate Digest — 2026-08-19
item.description: Today's 5 papers: Ultrafast and high resolution spatial light modulation for cold atoms; Nearly Sample-Optimal Estimators for Quantum Rényi and Tsallis Entropies; Quantum Geometric Tensor Preconditioning for Stable Training of Recurrent Neural Quantum States; Long-time fermionic quantum transport with controlled full-state error; Dynamics of Majorana tetron qubits under quasiparticle poisoning.
